sources.title: Adopted supplementary planning documents
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's adopted SPD page records planning guidance on S106 obligations, decentralised energy networks, site briefs and masterplans; adopted guidance informs decisions but does not itself determine a sample parcel.

sources.title: Enfield Design Review Panel
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Design Review Panel reviews pre-application and major schemes and its expert advice can be a material planning consideration, while the panel itself has no legal decision-making function.

sources.title: Local Development Scheme
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Local Development Scheme is the project plan for development-plan documents and was revised in May 2025; the page also records the 2023 Statement of Community Involvement.

sources.title: Emerging masterplans
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's emerging masterplans page describes Crews Hill and Chase Park masterplanning for around 9,000 homes alongside Local Plan work; emerging masterplans guide future applications but are not parcel permissions.

sources.title: Ecological assessments for planning applications
sources.verified_claim: Enfield requires ecological assessment where proposals may affect protected species, habitats, nature-conservation sites, rivers or green corridors; surveys and mapped site information may be needed before assessment.

sources.title: Epping Forest Special Area of Conservation
sources.verified_claim: Enfield applies SAMMs and SANGs mitigation contributions to relevant residential development in the Epping Forest SAC recreational zone of influence and states permission is not issued until required mitigation is secured; actual liability depends on proposal facts.

sources.title: Statement of Community Involvement
sources.verified_claim: Havering's Statement of Community Involvement sets the preferred methods and legal requirements for involving communities and stakeholders in plan preparation and planning-application decisions.

sources.title: Waste Planning
sources.verified_claim: Havering maintains a dedicated Waste Planning section within its planning-policy framework; waste-policy context must be checked alongside adopted and regional policies for any proposal.
